title: YouArt Desktop App
lede: YouArt Desktop is a video production agent that runs on your own machine, gathering context from local files and work apps and operating desktop editing tools directly through computer use.

points: Pulls local files plus context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto a single canvas of scripts, images, videos and comments.
Uses computer use to drive After Effects, CapCut and Blender rather than replacing them.
Targets jobs such as feature launch videos, remakes of viral formats and clips cut from long recordings.
Runs on your own API keys and routes each shot to the cheapest provider.
The team says the agent can switch between several LLMs and now handles much of their own daily video work.

sections.text: Creative and marketing teams whose video work already lives in desktop project folders and team chat, and who want an agent to carry a job end to end.
